verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm. Its digital offerings in the evidence are client-facing legal tools: questionnaire-driven document generators, a deal room, and AI review partnerships. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a software-platform axis that buyers comparing law firms would not reasonably ask about, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a scheduling or recurring-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
